copy.blurb: For Brazil versus Morocco, the model and The Market arrive at the same answer from different directions — within a point of each other on all three sides. That agreement is the story, not an empty result: two independent ways of estimating the same match converging is itself a signal that the price is about right. There is no side where the model sees value the market has missed, and none where it sees the reverse. So there is nothing to surface here beyond the convergence. We'll look again closer to kickoff, when confirmed line-ups and any late news can pull the two numbers apart.
